cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll have this shelf up before you leave. Could you hold the bracket against those holes for a moment?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Briefly. I'm dressed for work and I don't want dust on me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll catch the dust. Could you turn the top screw once so you can take your hand away?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding now. The other screws are lined up too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Just tighten those while they're ready, then slide the shelf on to check. I'll brush your sleeve and fetch your coat; we've kept the job moving beautifully.
